capabilities: Export embedded SVGs as PNG or JPEG with configured scale, quality, background, and destination
Copy selected Markdown as HTML plus plain text, HTML only, or plain text via several output profiles
Save selections or whole notes as full HTML documents or fragments with custom templates
Batch-export SVG embeds, folder notes, or linked notes with progress queues, reports, and manifests
Validate output for broken internal links, missing or external images, and SVG warnings
extras: Desktop-only (requires Obsidian 1.5.0+); installed manually from release assets (main.js, manifest.json, styles.css). README explains that the filesystem-access community-review notice covers Node writes only to the folder chosen in the save dialog, and notes output fidelity, portability, and file-size trade-offs when choosing style and asset modes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn embedded SVG images into portable raster images or to hand Markdown selections and notes off as styled HTML files.
